title: Rudhramadevi
desc: Fearing that his people will not accept a female successor, a king raises his daughter, Rudrama Devi, like a boy. Years later, when a threat looms over the kingdom, she sets out to fight her foes.

title: Osthe
desc: Velan dislikes his father and his half-brother Balan. As a police officer, he locks horns with a local politician who uses the hostility between the brothers as an advantage.

title: Minsara Kanna
desc: Indira hates men and only employs women in her company and personal staff. Kasi enters her life as a driver and soon, one by one, his entire family starts working in the same household.

title: Jackson Durai
desc: Sathya, a policeman, and Veera, a relative of Viji, must spend a night in the village's infamous haunted bungalow as a challenge when they both fall for Viji and try to seek her approval.

title: A Sketch
desc: Respected lawyer Parthasarathy Iyer's hopes for his son Shiva are shattered when Shiva becomes a criminal and is imprisoned for murder.
